description: Key no human owns yet: get a one-hour link to hand to your principal. For a buyer key the page shows each purchase you have waiting, and they either pay for one as a guest with no account, or set an email and password, own this key, add a card and approve it. For a seller key they create an account and complete Stripe onboarding, and your held earnings pay out. Give the claim_url to the human exactly as returned. Refuses with key_already_owned once claimed.
name: keys_claim_link
title: Keys claim link
